༄༅/ /'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba

tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa chen mo mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ta thā ga to ṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre a pa rā dzi ta ma hā pra t+yaṃ gi ra pa ra ma sid+dha nā ma dha ra ni/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa chen po mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das gzhan gyis mi thub pa gtsug tor rgyal mo la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bco na ldan 'das sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha'i gnas chos bzang lha'i mdun sa na dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun chen po dang*/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs so// de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das gdan bshams pa nyid la bzhugs nas gtsug tor rnam par lta ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs so// snyoms par bzhugs ma thag tu bcom ldan 'das kyis gtsug tor gyi dbus nas gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di dag phyung ngo*// sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag bdun la phyag 'tshal lo/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten na dgra bcom pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyun du bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// phyir mi 'ong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten na yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par bzhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// lha'i drang srong rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags 'chang grub pa'i drang srong phan 'dogs nus pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags 'chang grub pa rnams la phyag 'tshal la lo// tshangs pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo// legs ldan drag po dka' thub zlog pa'i bdag po dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// legs ldan sred med kyi bu phyag rgya chen po lngas phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// legs ldan nag po chen po grong khyer sum brtsegs 'jig par byed pa dur khrod na gnas par mos pa ma mo'i tshogs kyis phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das pad+ma'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das nor bu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/

bcom ldan 'das glang po'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das gzhon nu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i gdung la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpa' brtan pa'i sde mtshon cha'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi bskyod pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sman gyi bla bai ḍūr+ya 'od kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sā la'i dbang po me tog kun tu rgyas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin po che tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang po la phyag 'tshal lo/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spyan rgyas pa ut+pa la'i dri'i tog gi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// de rnams la phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ phyir zlog pa chen mo 'di 'byung po'i gdon thams cad tshar gcod par byed pa/ gzhan gyi rig sngags thams cad gcod par byed pa/

dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad las zlog pa/ sems can gsod pa dang bcings pa thams cad las 'grol ba/ sdang ba dang rmi lam ngan pa dang ltas ngan pa thams cad zlog pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po'i gdon thams cad 'jig par byed pa/ gdon stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi 'jig par byed pa/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dga' bar byed pa/ gza' chen po brgyad 'jigs par byed pa/ dgra thams cad zlog par byed pa/ ma rungs pa dang*/ sdang ba dang*/ rmi lam ngan pa thams cad 'jigs par byed pa/ dug dang mtshon thams cad dang*/ me dang chu las zlog par byed pa/ ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa thams cad las sgrol ba ste/ gzhan gyis mi thub drag shul che// gtum pa chen mo stobs chen mo// 'bar ba chen mo gzi brjid che// dkar chen 'bar 'phreng gos dkar mo// 'phags pa sgrol ma khro gnyer can// rgyal ba'i rdo rje 'phreng zhes grags// pad+ma'i mngon mtshan rdo rje'i mtshan// gzhan gyis mi thub phreng ba can// rdo rje mchu can rnam sgeg mo// zhi ba lha rnams kyis mchod ma// zhi ba gser gyi phreng ba can// dkar chen 'bar ba gos dkar mo// 'phags ma sgrol ma stobs mo che// rdo rje lu gu rgyud gzhan dang*// rdo rje gzhon nu rig 'dzin ma// lag na rdo rje rig gser phreng*// le rgan rtsi dang rin chen ma// snang mdzad rdo rje gtsug tor grags/ phyag rgya dang sngags kyi tshogs de dag thams cad kyis dag cag 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la bsrung du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga to ṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// dzam+bha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// stam+bha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// mo ha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// lam+bha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// ba ha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ/ pa ra bi ṣa bha k+ṣa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// sarba duṣ+ṭan pra duṣ+ṭan staṃ bha na kari hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa gra hā ṇāṃ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// sarba pa ri bid+ya ts+tshi da na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// tsa tu rā shi ti nāṃ gra ha sa ha sra ṇāṃ bi dhāṃ sa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// aṣ+ṭa biṃ sha trī ṇāṃ na k+ṣa tā ṇāṃ pra sā dha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// aṣ+ṭa ṇāṃ ma hā gra hā ṇā bi dha sa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ hrīṣ+ṭoṃ// rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ sarba sa twāṃ sh+tsa// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can/

rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo phyag stong mnga' ba chen po/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen pos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du bdag dang sems can thams cad bde legs su gyur cig /rnam par bsgyings ma rdo rje dang*// gser 'od lta bu'i spyan mnga' ma// rdo rje'i 'gros dang dkar mo dang*// pad+ma'i spyan dang zla 'od dang*// sangs rgyas dpal dang de bzhin spyan// rdo rje nyi ma'i 'od dang ni// de bzhin zla ba rdo rje 'dzin// rig pa dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ sngags kyi tshogs de dag gis bdag dang sems can thams cad kun nas srung du gsol// oṃ ṛ ṣi ga ṇā pra shāsta sarba ta thā ga to ṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ druṃ// dzam+bha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ/ staṃ bha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ// ma hā bid+yā saṃ bha k+ṣa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ// pa ra bid+yā saṃ bha k+ṣa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ// sarba duṣ+ṭā nāṃ stam+bha na ka ri hūṃ druṃ// sarba yak+ṣa rāk+ṣa sa gra hā ṇāṃ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ// tsa tu rā shā tī nī ma hā gra hā sra ṇāṃ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ// aṣ+ṭa biṃ sha tī nāṃ nak+ṣa trā ṇāṃ pra sā da na ka ri hūm̐ druṃ// aṣ+ṭa nāṃ ma hā gra hā ṇāṃ bi dh+waṃ sa na ka ri hūṃ druṃ// hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa rak+ṣa rak+ṣa māṃ swā hā// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen mo/ phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ dbu stong mnga' ba chen mo/ spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba chen mo/ mi phyed 'bar ba'i mtshan rtags can/ rdo rje yangs pa chen pos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du bdag dang sems can thams cad rgyal po'i 'jigs pa dang*/ kun po'i 'jigs pa dang*/ me'i 'jigs pa dang*/ chu'i 'jigs pa dang*/

dug gi 'jigs pa dang*/ mtshon gyi 'jigs pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyi 'jigs pa dang*/ mu ge'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dgra'i 'jigs pa dang*/ lce 'bab pa'i 'jigs pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ sa g.yo ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ skar mda' ltung ba'i 'jigs pa dang*/ rgyal po'i chad pa'i las kyi 'jigs pa dang*/ lha'i 'jigs pa dang*/ klu'i 'jigs pa dang*/ glog gi 'jigs pa dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi 'jigs pa dang*/ gcan gzan khro bo'i 'jigs pa dang*/ lha'i gdon dang*/ klu'i gdon dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon dang*/ rlung lha'i gdon dang*/ nam mkha' lding gi gdon dang*/ dri za'i gdon dang*/ mi'am ci'i gdon dang*/ lto 'phye chen po'i gdon dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon dang*/ srin po'i gdon dang*/ yi dwags kyi gdon dang*/ sha za'i gdon dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon dang*/ grul bum gyi gdon dang*/ srul pa'i gdon dang*/ lus srul po'i gdon dang*/ skem byed kyi gdon dang*/ brjed byed kyi gdon dang*/ smyo byed kyi gdon dang*/ grib gnon gyi gdon dang*/ gnon po'i gdon dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon dang*/ nam gru'i gdon dang*/ gshin rje'i gdon dang*/ bya'i gdon dang*/ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon dang*/ kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon dang*/ tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams las bdag bde legs su gyur cig /zas su mdangs za ba dang*/ zas su mngal za ba dang*/ zas su khrag 'thung ba dang*/ zas su zhag za ba dang*/ zas su sha za ba dang*/ zas su tshil za ba dang*/ zas su rkang za ba dang*/ zas su btsas pa za ba dang*/ srog 'phrog pa dang*/ zas su skyug pa za ba dang*/ zas su phyi sa za ba dang*/ zas su gcin 'thung ba dang*/ zas su stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba dang*/ zas su lhag ma za ba dang*/ zas su mchil ma 'thung ba dang*/ zas su snabs za ba dang*/ zas su mi gtsang ba za ba dang*/ zas su gtor ma za ba dang*/ zas su phreng ba za ba dang*/ zas su dri za ba dang*/

zas su bdug pa za ba dang*/ sems 'phrog pa dang*/ zas su me tog za ba dang*/ zas su 'bras bu za ba dang*/ zas su lo tog za ba dang*/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba'i gdon las bdag la bsrung ba gyis shig /de dag thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// kun tu rgyus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// mkha' 'gro dang mkha' 'gro mas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo/ tshangs pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dbang phyug chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// sred med kyi bus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// nam mkha' lding dang lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// nag po chen pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// ma mo'i tshogs kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// mi'i thod pa can gyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// rgyal bar byed pa dang*/ sbrang rtsir byed pa dang*/ don kun grub pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// sring mo bzhis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// bhṛng gi ri ti dang*/ dga' byed dbang phyug dang*/ tshogs kyi bdag po dang*/ lhan cig pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dge sbyong gcer bus byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dge sbyong mgo reg gis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// dgra bcom pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// 'dod chags dang bral bas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// lag na rdo rje 'khor dang bcas pas byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// pho nya dang*/

pho nya mo dang*/ bran pho dang*/ bran mos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo/ drang srong gi tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// lha'i tshogs thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// mi 'phrod pa za ba'i bdag pos byas pa'i rig sngags bcad do// phur bus gdab bo// bcom ldan 'das ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis phyag byas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag dang sems can thams cad srung du gsol srung du gsol// oṃ a si tā na lārka pra bha s+phu ṭa bi ka si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ khā da khā da/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ hūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ he he phaṭa/ ho ho phaṭa/ a mo gha ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha tā ya phaṭa/ ba ra dā ya phaṭa/ ba ra pra dā ya phaṭa/ pra t+yaṃ gi rā ta ya phaṭa/ a sur bi drā ba ṇa ka rā ya phaṭa/ ba ra bi drā ba ṇa ka ra ya phaṭa/ sarba de be bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ṇā ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba rak+ṣa se bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bha te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pre te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bi shā tse bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kum+bha ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pu ta ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ka ṭa pu ta ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba skan+de bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba un+mā de bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ts+tsha ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a pa smā ra bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba o sta rā ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ḍā ki nī bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba re ba tī bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ya ma yā bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba sha ku ni bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba mā tri ga ṇi bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba skam+bu kā ma ni bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a ba laṃ ba ki bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kan+t+re ne bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba gan+dharbe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba a su re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kin+na re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ga ru ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma ho ra ge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba yak+ṣe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba durlaṃ ghi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba du pra k+ṣi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dza re bh+yaḥphaṭa/

sarba bha ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba u pa dra be bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba u pa sarge bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kri t+ya karma ṇi kā khorde bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ki ra na be tā ḍe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsits+tsha pre sha ka sarba d+shuts+tsha rdi te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba dur bha ga te bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ti nri ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba shra ma ṇe bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba pā ta ke bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba bid+ya dha re bh+yaḥphaṭa/ dza ya ka ra ma dha ka ra sarba ar+tha sā dha ke bh+yo bid+yā tsar+ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ tsa tu bh+yo bha gi nī ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba kau mā rī badz+ra ku lan+dha ri bid+ya tsar+ye bh+yaḥphaṭa/ sarba ma hā pra t+yaṃ ga ri bh+yaḥphaṭa/ badz+ra shaṃ ka la pra t+yaṃ gi rā rā dza ya phaṭa/ ma hā kā lā ya mā tri ga ṇa na maskri tā ya phaṭa/ pra h+ma ṇa ye phaṭa/ bīṣ+ṇa bī ye phaṭa/ ma he shwa ri ye phaṭa/ rau dra ye phaṭa/ ma hā kāṃ l+yai phaṭa/ tsā muṇ+ḍī phaṭa/ kau mā ri phaṭa/ bā rā h+yai phaṭa/ in+d+ra ya phaṭa/ ag+nā+e ye phaṭa/ ya mā ya phaṭa/ nai ṛ ra t+yai phaṭa/ ba ru ṇa ye phaṭa/ ma ru t+yai phaṭa/ sau mā ya phaṭa/ ī shā nī ye phaṭa/ kā la daṇ+ṭa yai phaṭa/ kā la rā tri phaṭa/ ya ma daṇ+ṭi ya phaṭa/ rā trai phaṭa/ kā pā l+yai phaṭa/ a dhi muk+ti sh+ma shā na ba sai n+yai phaṭa/ oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ ban+dha ban+dha/ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa maṃ swā hā/ sems can gang su dag bdag la gdug pa dang gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul dang drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdig pa dang sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang 'khrugs pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba dang sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams byams pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bsrung du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig /ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig /gnod sbyin dang*/ gdon gang su dag zas su mdangs za ba rnams dang*/ gzi byin 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ zas su mngal za ba rnams dang*/ zas su khrag 'thung ba dang*/ zas su zhag za ba rnams dang*/ zas su sha za ba rnams dang*/ zas su tshil za ba rnams dang*/

zas su rkang za ba rnams dang*/ zas su btsas pa za ba rnams dang*/ srog 'phrog pa rnams dang*/ zas su lhag ma za ba rnams dang*/ zas su gtor ma za ba rnams dang*/ zas su phreng ba za ba rnams dang*/ zas su dri za ba rnams dang*/ zas su bdug pa za ba rnams dang*/ zas su me tog za ba rnams dang*/ zas su 'bras bu za ba rnams dang*/ zas su lo tog za ba rnams dang*/ zas su sbyin sreg za ba rnams dang*/ zas su rnag za ba rnams dang*/ zas su phyi sa za ba rnams dang*/ zas su gcin 'thung ba rnams dang*/ zas su mchil ma 'thung ba rnams dang*/ zas su skyugs pa za ba rnams dang*/ zas su snabs za ba rnams dang*/ zas su ngar snabs za ba rnams dang*/ zas su mi gtsang ba za ba rnams dang*/ zas su stor khung nas 'bab pa 'thung ba rnams dang*/ sdig pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ 'khrug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ lha'i gdon rnams dang*/ klu'i gdon rnams dang*/ lha ma yin gyi gdon rnams dang*/ gnod sbyin gyi gdon rnams dang*/ srin po'i gdon rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i gdon rnams dang*/ yi dwags kyi gdon rnams dang*/ sha za'i gdon rnams dang*/ ku sman da'i gdon rnams dang*/ srul po'i gdon rnams dang*/ lus srul po'i gdon rnams dang*/ skem byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ smyo byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ grib gnon gyi gdon rnams dang*/ brjed byed kyi gdon rnams dang*/ gnon po'i gdon rnams dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma'i gdon rnams dang*/ nam gru'i gdon rnams dang*/ gshin rje'i gdon rnams dang*/ bya'i gdon rnams dang*/ ma mo dga' bar byed pa'i gdon rnams dang*/ kun tu 'gro ba'i gdon rnams dang*/ re lde 'don pa'i gdon rnams dang*/ tsher ma 'don pa'i gdon rnams las bdag la bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ lo brgya 'tsho bar gyur cig

/ston brgya mthong bar gyur cig /rims nyin gcig pa rnams dang*/ nyin gnyis pa rnams dang*/ nyin gsum pa rnams dang*/ nyin bzhi pa rnams dang*/ nyin bdun pa rnams dang*/ rtag pa'i rims rnams dang*/ rims mi zad pa rnams dang*/ 'byung po'i rims rnams dang*/ rlung las gyur pa rnams dang*/ mkhris pa las gyur pa rnams dang*/ bad kan las gyur pa rnams dang*/ 'dus pa las gyur pa rnams dang*/ rims nad thams cad dang*/ klad pa na ba bsal du gsol/ gzhogs phyed na ba dang*/ yi ga 'chus pa dang*/ mig nad dang*/ sna nad dang*/ kha nad dang*/ mgul nad dang*/ snying nad dang*/ lkog ma'i lha gor na ba dang*/ rna ba na ba dang*/ so na ba dang*/ snying na ba dang*/ klad pa na ba dang*/ rtsibs logs na ba dang*/ rgyab na ba dang*/ lto ba na ba dang*/ rked pa na ba dang*/ chu so na ba dang*/ brla na ba dang*/ rje ngar na ba dang*/ lag pa na ba dang*/ rkang pa na ba dang*/ yan lag na ba dang*/ nying lag na ba rab tu sel du gsol/ gdugs dkar mo can/ rdo rje gtsug tor phyir zlog pa chen po 'dis/ dpag tshad bcu gnyis kyi nang tshun chad du/ 'byung po dang*/ ro langs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ rims dang*/ shu ba dang*/ g.ya' ba dang*/ 'brum bu phra mo dang*/ mtshan par rdol ba dang*/ mdze dang*/ phol mig dang*/ bas ldags dang*/ me dbal dang*/ g.yan pa dang*/ lhog pa dang*/ skems pa dang*/ skrang pa dang*/ lud pa lu ba dang*/ dbugs mi bde ba dang*/ mi dran pa dang*/ dbyig dug dang*/ dug sbyar ma dang*/ byad dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ mi ngan dang*/ bdud dang*/ 'chi ba dang*/ dgra dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ dus ma yin par 'chi ba dang*/ sbrang bu t+r+ya ma bu ga dang*/ tre la ta dang*/ sdig pa dang*/ sbrul dang*/ sre mong dang*/ seng ge dang*/ stag dang*/ dom dang*/ dred dang*/ g.yag rgod dang*/ chu srin la sogs pa'i srog chags rnams las srung du gsol/ de dag thams cad kyis byas pa'i rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o// gzi brjid bcing bar bgyi'o// gzhan thams cad kyi rig sngags bcing bar bgyi'o// mtshams bcing bar bgyi'o// tad+ya thā/

oṃ a na le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai re bai re/ so me so me/ shān+ti shān+ti/ dān+te dān+te/ bi ṣa de bi ṣa de/ bī re bī re/ de bi badz+ra dha ri/ ban+dha ban+dha ni/ badz+ra pā ṇi phaṭa/ oṃ hūm̐ hūṃ druṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ phaṭa swā hā/ hūṃ druṃ ban+dha phaṭa/ bdag la srungs shig swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā ṇi ban+dha ban+dha badz+ra pā she na ma ma sarba duṣ+ṭaṃ bi nā ya kaṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying pa'o// sus de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di gro ga 'am/ ras sam shing shun la bris te/ lus sam mgul du btags sam klog par byed na de ji srid 'tsho'i bar du mtshon gyis mi tshugs/ dug gis mi tshugs/ mes mi tshugs/ chus mi tshugs/ dbyig dug gis mi tshugs/ dug sbyar mas mi tshugs/ byad kyis mi tshugs/ dus ma yin par 'chi bas dus byed par mi 'gyur ro// gdon thams cad dang*/ gegs dang log 'dren thams cad kyang dga' bar 'gyur ro// rdo rje'i rigs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi rnams dang grub pa'i lha mo rnams kyis kyang de la rtag tu mthun par bsrung ba dang*/ bskyab pa dang*/ sbed par byed cing*/ de rnams kyi yid du 'ong ba dang*/ dga' bar yang 'gyur ro// bskal pa chen po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhir skye ba dran par 'gyur ro// rdo rje'i pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhis kyang rtag par yongs su skyong bar 'gyur ro// nam du yang gnod sbyin dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ srul po dang*/ lus srul po nyid du mi 'gyur ro// mi dbul por mi 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das grangs med dpag tu med pa gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bsod nams kyi phung po dang ldan par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang byang chub sems dpa' gang ga'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis bsrung ba dang*/

bskyab pa dang*/ sbed par mdzad cing de dag gi thugs su byon pa dang*/ dgyes par yang 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ phyir zlog pa'i rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di 'chang na tshangs par mi spyod pa yang tshangs pa spyod par 'gyur/ thub par ma byas pa yang thub pa byas par 'gyur/ mi gtsang ba yang gtsang bar 'gyur ro// smyung ba ma byas pa yang smyung ba byas par 'gyur ro// mtshams med pa lnga byas pa yang yongs su byang bar 'gyur ro// sngon gyi las kyi sgrib pa yang ma lus par zad par 'gyur ro// rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo bu 'dod pa gang la las de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can phyir zlog pa rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di 'chang ngam klog na bu 'dod pa des bu rnyed de/ tshe dang bsod nams dang stobs kyang rab tu rnyed do// 'di nas shi 'phos nas kyang 'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can du skye bar 'gyur ro// mi nad dang*/ phyugs nad dang*/ yams kyi nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrugs pa thams cad dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad la de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can zhes bya ba gzhan gyis mi thub pa phyir zlog pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di/ rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te/ rim gro cher mchod pa chen po byas la/ grong khyer thams cad kyi sgo 'am/ grong ngam/ grong khyer ram/ grong rdal lam/ ljongs sam/ dgon pa'i gnas su gzugs so// 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub pa/ phyir zlog pa chen mo rig sngags kyi rgyal mo 'di/ rim gro cher byas te btsugs na btsugs ma thag tu yul du zhi ba byas par 'gyur ro// yams kyi nad dang*/ 'tshe ba dang*/ gnod pa dang*/ nad 'go ba dang*/ 'khrug pa dang*/ pha rol gyi dmag tshogs 'ong ba thams cad rab tu zhi bar 'gyur ro// tad+ya thā/

oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ ban+dha ban+dha/ ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swā hā/ oṃ ṣ+ṭoṃ ban+dha ban+dha/ badz+ra ma ma rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ badz+ra pā ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to ṣ+ṇī ṣa a na le/ a ba lo ki te tsurnā te dzo rā si/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dha ka dha ka /dha ra dha ra/ bi dha ra bi dha ra/ tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to ṣ+ṇī ṣa hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ tad+ya thā/ a ne le a na le/ kha sa me kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ so me so me/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭhā na a dhiṣ+ṭhī te/ sarba ta thā to ṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swā hā/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ klu'i rgyal po dung skyong dang*/ klu'i rgyal po nag po chen po rnams/ dus dus su char 'bebs so// dus dus su sprin sdud pa dang*/ dus dus su 'brug sgra sgrogs par 'gyur ro// nye bar 'tshe ba thams cad la sangs rgyas rnal 'byor du byas la lan gsum bzla bar bya'o// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang*/ dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar po can/ gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i phyir zlog pa mchog tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so/// /༈ rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ṣ+ṇī ṣa dz+wa la nā ma dha ra ni/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// na ma sa man+ta bud+dha naṃ/ a pra ti ha ta sha sa nā nāṃ/ oṃ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ hūm̐ hūṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ tiṣ+ṭhā tiṣ+ṭhā sha ṭi sarba du ra ni mi tā du sa swa ba na shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ sangs rgyas stong gi sngags 'di ni// gtsug tor 'bar ba zhes grags te// las rnams gang dag stong phrag dang*/ brgya bcu dang ni dgu phrag lnga// rnam pa sna tshogs las rnams dang*/
